capability: Conditional-GET contract of every read served through Responses.cachedOk: an ETag is issued, a matching If-None-Match yields 304 with no body, a non-matching one yields 200, the wildcard and multi-value forms are honoured, the tag changes when the collection changes, and the reads that do not use cachedOk carry neither ETag nor Cache-Control.
